scripts.prisma:generate: prisma generate --schema=../web/prisma/schema.prisma && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve(__dirname,'../../node_modules/.prisma/client'); const dest=path.resolve(__dirname,'node_modules/@prisma/client/.prisma/client'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), {recursive:true}); fs.rmSync(dest, {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true, force:true});"
scripts.postinstall: prisma generate --schema=../web/prisma/schema.prisma && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve(__dirname,'../../node_modules/.prisma/client'); const dest=path.resolve(__dirname,'node_modules/@prisma/client/.prisma/client'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), {recursive:true}); fs.rmSync(dest, {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true, force:true});"
